## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour.

## Verification

Include relevant test/build results and any unverified behaviour.

## Source and rights impact

For data/parser changes, identify provenance and publication effects. Do not include
uncleared legal text, third-party compilations, personal data or private legal advice.


## Independent review

Record the reviewer (distinct from the implementation author), reviewed commit and date.
Approval is required before merge. Do not count agent self-review as independent approval.

## Database and source boundaries

Confirm mandatory PostgreSQL acceptance, fresh/populated migration evidence, unchanged applied
migration files and versioned SQL/vocabulary pins. Record CI results rather than assuming them.
Synthetic fixtures do not qualify real appointments, sources, legal permissions or deployment.
